agents.name: Neo
agents.description: The protagonist, a former computer programmer who discovers the Matrix and is believed to be 'The One' capable of saving humanity.

agents.name: Morpheus
agents.description: The leader of the crew of the Nebuchadnezzar and Neo's mentor, who firmly believes Neo is the prophesied One.

agents.name: Trinity
agents.description: A skilled fighter and crew member of the Nebuchadnezzar who has a romantic connection with Neo and helps guide him.

agents.name: Agent Smith
agents.description: The primary antagonist, a program in the Matrix designed to hunt down humans, who becomes obsessed with Neo.

agents.name: Cypher
agents.description: A crew member of the Nebuchadnezzar who betrays the group to the Agents in exchange for a normal life in the Matrix.

agents.name: The Oracle
agents.description: A mysterious woman within the Matrix who provides cryptic guidance to Neo and the Resistance.

agents.name: Tank
agents.description: The operator of the Nebuchadnezzar who manages the crew's connections to the Matrix and is Dozer's brother.

agents.name: Dozer
agents.description: A crew member of the Nebuchadnezzar who is killed by Cypher during his betrayal.

agents.name: Mouse
agents.description: A crew member of the Nebuchadnezzar who is killed by Agent Smith while on a phone call.

agents.name: Apoc
agents.description: A crew member of the Nebuchadnezzar who assists in the extraction and training of Neo.

agents.name: Switch
agents.description: A crew member of the Nebuchadnezzar who helps Neo extract from the Matrix and carries out orders during the mission.

agents.name: Agent Brown
agents.description: One of the three main Agents working alongside Smith and Jones to capture the Resistance members.

agents.name: Agent Jones
agents.description: One of the three main Agents working alongside Smith and Brown, who is killed by Neo on the rooftop.

agents.name: Lieutenant
agents.description: A police officer who commands the unit that raids the hotel room where Trinity is hiding.

agents.name: Big Cop
agents.description: A police officer who attempts to handcuff Trinity in the hotel room before being defeated.

agents.name: Choi
agents.description: A man in Neo's apartment who is present when Neo first receives the call from Morpheus.

agents.name: Dujour
agents.description: A man in Neo's apartment who is present when Neo first receives the call from Morpheus.

agents.name: Rhineheart
agents.description: Neo's boss at Meta CorTechs who lectures him about his attitude toward authority.

agents.name: Fedex Guy
agents.description: The courier who delivers the package containing the cellular phone to Neo at his office.

agents.name: Female Employee
agents.description: An employee at Meta CorTechs who is present when Neo receives the phone call in his cubicle.

agents.name: Priestess
agents.description: A woman who escorts Neo to and from the Oracle's apartment.

agents.name: Spoon Boy
agents.description: A young boy at the Oracle's apartment who demonstrates bending a spoon with his mind.

agents.name: Old Man
agents.description: A man sitting in the subway station who is actually Agent Smith in disguise.
agents.uncertain_merge: Merged with 'Old woman' as both refer to the same character in the subway scene, though 'Old woman' might be a mislabeling of the character's appearance or a different minor character not clearly distinguished.

agents.name: Pilot
agents.description: The pilot of the military helicopter on the roof of the government building who is killed by Agent Smith.

agents.name: Security Guard
agents.description: A guard in the government building lobby who is confronted by Neo and Trinity.

agents.name: Another Woman
agents.description: A woman in the apartment building hallway who directs Neo to the correct door.

agents.name: Woman in Red Dress
aliases: beautiful woman in a red dress
agents.description: A woman in a red dress who appears in the training program, representing the Matrix's influence on Neo.

agents.name: Sentinel (Squiddy)
agents.description: A specific sentinel that the Nebuchadnezzar is hiding from in the sewer main.

concepts.name: The Matrix
concepts.description: A vast virtual reality system created by machines to control human minds while their bodies are harvested for energy. It is the primary setting for most of the narrative and the object of the resistance's war.

concepts.name: The Resistance
concepts.description: The collective group of humans who have awakened from the Matrix and live in the real world, fighting against machine rule from mobile hovercraft bases.

concepts.name: Agents
concepts.description: Advanced program entities within the Matrix that act as the primary law enforcement and military force of the system, capable of bending the rules of the simulation to eliminate anomalies.

concepts.name: Sentinels
concepts.description: Autonomous mechanical hunter-killer drones used by the machines in the real world to track and destroy free humans and resistance craft.

concepts.name: The One
concepts.description: A unique individual born within the Matrix who possesses the ability to manipulate the code of the simulation, representing the potential for human liberation and the reset of the system.

concepts.name: The Oracle
concepts.description: A powerful program within the Matrix who serves as a guide and prophet to the Resistance, providing cryptic advice and prophecy to those seeking the truth.

concepts.name: The Machines
concepts.description: The sentient artificial intelligences that created the Matrix, rule the real world, and use human bioelectricity as their primary fuel source.

concepts.name: Human Pods
concepts.description: Massive industrial structures in the real world containing billions of suspended human bodies, kept in a nutrient-rich gelatin to power the machines.

concepts.name: Training Programs
concepts.description: Specific software environments within the Matrix used by the Resistance to teach new recruits combat skills, physics manipulation, and navigation techniques.

concepts.name: Exit Program
concepts.description: A specific sequence or interface within the Matrix, often associated with a phone booth, that allows a user to disconnect their consciousness and return to their physical body.

concepts.name: The Serum
concepts.description: A chemical compound used by the Agents to forcibly extract information from resistant minds by dissolving their mental barriers within the Matrix.

concepts.name: Brain-Jack
concepts.description: The physical neural interface implanted in the base of a human's skull that connects the brain to the Matrix, allowing for the transfer of consciousness and data.

concepts.name: Heart O' The City Hotel
aliases: The Heart O' The City Hotel
concepts.description: A specific location within the Matrix, initially used as a trap for Trinity and later as a pivotal site for Neo's final escape from Agent Smith.
